name: ate-a-falha
description: Sistema de Gerenciamento de Dietas e Treinos.

scripts.setup: docker compose up -d --build && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api npm run db:migrate -w @ate-a-falha/database
scripts.db:migrate:dev: docker compose exec -it api sh -c "cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate dev"
scripts.db:generate: docker compose exec api npm run db:generate -w @ate-a-falha/database
scripts.db:studio: docker compose exec api npm run db:studio -w @ate-a-falha/database
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api npm run db:seed -w @ate-a-falha/database
